prediction_rule: Only emitted forehand/backhand events count as positives. No positive events is negative, including zero classified windows. Mixed positives retain both classes and must never collapse to negative.

acceptance.missing_or_failed_runs: fail, never convert inference errors or omitted clips to negative

legacy_snapshot_override: This policy supersedes the embedded unsure-exclusion evaluation metadata in frozen v2 snapshots. It does not rewrite annotations, included flags, source intervals or frozen bytes.
split_grouping: source recording, never independently split overlapping clips
representativeness: starter corpus; not a general accuracy benchmark
